title: Countdown with a step
description: Count down from start in steps of step. Print the current value as `T-minus V` on its own line, subtract step, and repeat while the value is still above zero. When the value is no longer above zero, print `liftoff`; zero itself is never printed as a count. Return how many `T-minus` lines were printed. If step is zero or negative, print only `bad step: STEP` (STEP with its sign) and return 0, without any `liftoff`. If start is zero or negative, only `liftoff` is printed and 0 is returned.
notes: Level 1. Loop with a step; the bad-step check comes before everything else (start 0 with step 0 is a bad step, no liftoff); a count that lands exactly on 0 is not printed; step larger than start prints one count; negative step is reported with its sign. Largest test value 9e15, below 2^53.
